decision.reason: The only evidence is one release-note line [ev-1861adfd42be]: cert-manager now skips Gateway TLS listeners in Passthrough mode. It does not give the API group, the field path (spec.listeners[].tls.mode) or the literal value the proposed condition uses. It also does not say which Gateways cert-manager handles at all. If cert-manager only acts on Gateways that are opted in (for example by annotation or by enabling a component), a condition on the listener mode alone would also flag environments that are not exposed. To decide, I would need the PR #6986 diff or docs that name the field, its value, and the conditions under which cert-manager processes a Gateway.
